summary: Tidewater filed an 8-K confirming completion of its acquisition of Wilson Sons Ultratug Participacoes and Atlantic Offshore Services from Wilson Sons, Ultranav and Remolcadores, closed August 31, 2026 under an Amended and Restated SPA dated August 25, 2026. Post-closing, the 8-K addresses BNDES construction loans: Tidewater must use best endeavors by December 31, 2026 to replace or repay the sellers' parent guarantees and release them, backstopped by up to USD 170,458,000 of unsecured DNB Bank ASA replacement letters of credit. Watch financing/guarantee releases and integration risk.
